name: Extend Data Services Permission Definition
description: Authorization for user access. The template's creator-scoped policies are deliberately absent: this is a single-household system in which the Runtime and the User work on the same Things. See DECISIONS.md D-010.

policies.name: User Has Actuator Path Access
policies.description: Users with access right ACCESS_ACTUATOR are allowed to access /actuator/** path

policies.name: Reload Authorization Rules by System-Admin
policies.description: Users with access right RELOAD_AUTH_RULES are allowed to access /uaa-authorization/reloadRules path

policies.name: User Has ASSISTANT_WRITE Right For An Assistant
policies.description: An Assistant is written by the User only -- the Runtime reads it (D-007a). The Data Service checks the three document write scopes with three different resource shapes, so all three are recognised here: the model name alone (checkDocumentCreatePermissionByModel, the cheap pre-check in DefaultDocumentService), the DocumentV2 being created, and the DocumentUpdateResource carrying the old and new document. Any other shape falls through to 'not an Assistant', so an unforeseen call path can never be denied by this rule.
rules: hasAccessRight('ASSISTANT_WRITE') or !({'Assistant_DM'}.contains(#resource instanceof T(java.lang.String) ? #resource : (#resource instanceof T(com.mgmtp.a12.kernel.md.document.apiV2.immutable.DocumentV2) ? #resource.getDocumentModelId() : null)) or (#resource instanceof T(com.mgmtp.a12.dataservices.authorization.DocumentUpdateResource) and ({'Assistant_DM'}.contains(#resource.getNewDocument()?.getDocumentModelId()) or {'Assistant_DM'}.contains(#resource.getOldDocument()?.getDocumentModelId()))))

permissions.name: Actuator Access Permission
permissions.description: Control actuator accessibility by relative URL

permissions.name: Assistant Write Permission
permissions.description: Withholds Assistant_DM from every role without ASSISTANT_WRITE, which is the `runtime` role. `call-parent-scope` defaults to true, so the parent definition's DOCUMENT_CREATE / DOCUMENT_UPDATE / DOCUMENT_PARTIAL_UPDATE checks still run and every permission on the scope must pass.
